Undocumented ReSharper property; classified as C#-relevant by vocabulary. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified unreachable / inert. Flat at line_break, same_line, no_indent and outdent on two label fixtures — one with the label on its own line, one sharing a line with its statement — and at max_line_length = 40. The positive control is on the same fixture: resharper_csharp_indent_size at 4 against 8 gives two distinct oracle outputs, so the fixture's indentation does move. ⚠ Both engines disagree on label layout at baseline; that is a pre-existing divergence and not this key's.
